decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program sits close to the core offer and needs little dedicated investment, but it overlaps with the broader express line D and could be folded into it.
The seventy-two-hour delivery promise is costly to sustain, yet it fits the announced focus on fast response, and management would likely blame any weak uptake on temporary market conditions.

The fire-resistant exterior door was publicly launched at BAU with European approval and extends the core Teckentrup 62 system, so the sunk certification costs and visible commitment strongly favor keeping it.
The multi-model express line has its own web page and supports the firm's fast-delivery positioning, which makes it a visible strategic commitment the firm will persist with.

The digital platform carries substantial development investment, has a dedicated page, and is central to the announced direction of deeper service, so disappointing results would be treated as start-up difficulties.
The fire and smoke protection door belongs to the certified core safety portfolio, and its approval investment makes withdrawal unlikely.
